#schema: # The finalization pass-through invokes `shirabe validate --format json
# --visibility=<repo-visibility>` against the Draft STRATEGY and parses the
# versioned validator envelope. Both flags are load-bearing: `--format json`
# is what makes the output parseable, and `--visibility` overrides per-file
# detection with the repo posture the parent already resolved.
# git backs the child-doc drift check (`git hash-object -w`), the dispatch
# liveness check (`git log`), and the rejection path's `git rm`.
# /charter opens no PR itself -- its children do -- so no gh record appears.
